stem: Which characteristic best identifies this story as a myth?

options.label: F
options.text: The story uses impossible events to explain the origin of something natural.

options.label: G
options.text: The story includes the actions and dialogue of several characters.

options.label: H
options.text: The story includes a setting that is unoccupied by humans.

options.label: J
options.text: The story takes place a very long time ago.
